author: Joltz_
body:
So when I was bored (Explains the name Ennui, which is french for Bored, atleast I hope Google translate was right :P) I decided, y'know what? screw it, Lets make a nebula map, It's nowhere near finishing, but I thought I should post this to see what people think how it is.

Idea for this map:
There are 2 spacecrafts, the other team needs to break the others engine (Obsidian) In order to win. There will be a Massive Fighting area, Maybe a huge tower :P idk, I just want Symmetry really. Its actually based on Futurama.

Teams
Orange- Igavus (Estonian for Bored)
Brown- Dosada (Croatian for Bored)

My current to do list:
I am going to make the ground deeper for people to tunnel.
Add more detail to spacecraft
Finish battle area

Note:
It may look bad, but I'm getting a friend to put in some detail and stuff


Picture 1:  The map as it currently stands (These pictures will be updated)
Picture 2: The Monument area (It acts as if it was the engine of the spacecraft)
Picture 3: Team spawn facing towards Iron area and prep stuff.
